test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: An inlet pipe can fill an empty tank in 3.6 hours, while an outlet pipe can drain a completely-filled tank in 6.3 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty, in how many hours will the tank get completely filled?
solution:
**Given:**

An inlet pipe fills tank in = 3.6 hours

Outlet pipe drains tank in = 6.3 hours

**Solution:**

Rate of inlet pipe = 1 / 3.6 Rate of outlet pipe = 1 / 6.3

Net rate when both are open = 1 / 3.6 - 1 / 6.3

Find the LCM of 36 and 63 to simplify the calculation, which is 252.

Net rate = (70/252) - (40/252) = 30/252 = 5/42

Time to fill the tank when both pipes are open = 1 / Net rate = 42 / 5

**Time to fill tank = 8.4 hours**
